sources: Esri World Imagery around 37.8329,-90.2261 with the UseDirect site points

values.note: Park's own 2026 and 2027 rate sheets (identical): on-season (April-October) basic/walk-in $15, electric 30A $27, electric 50A $29; off-season (November-March) $14 / $23 / $25. Backcountry $10, backcountry group $20. Rates include sales tax; $6.50 online reservation fee per site.

fees.source: https://mostateparks.com/sites/g/files/zuston361/files/media/pdf/2026/01/hawn-camping-fees-2027.pdf (ON-SEASON (April through October) / OFF-SEASON (November through March): 'Basic/Walk-In $15 $14'; 'Electric - 30 AMP $27 $23'; 'Electric - 50 AMP $29 $25'; '**Backcountry Camping $10 $10'; '**Backcountry [Group] $20 $20') + CampingFees_Hawn_26.pdf (same figures), read 2026-11-07. Basic pads are 50-58 ft, so a 23-ft rig fits the basic base.

values.note: $2 a night off year-round for seniors 65+, persons with disabilities, military and veterans; ask at payment, with proof.

discounts.source: https://mostateparks.com/sites/g/files/zuston361/files/media/pdf/2026/01/hawn-camping-fees-2027.pdf ('A $2 PER NIGHT CAMPING DISCOUNT' ... 'military and veterans'), read 2026-11-07

hookups.source: https://mostateparks.com/park/hawn/camping ('Basic, Electric*, Walk-in'; '* 50-amp electric sites available') + UseDirect grid (9 'Electric 50 amp', 16 'Electric 30 amp'; no water or sewer site types), read 2026-11-07

sites.source: https://msprdr.usedirect.com/MSPRDR/rdr/search/grid PlaceId 42, facility 780: 49 units - 9 electric 50A (31-58 ft), 16 electric 30A (51-57 ft), 19 basic (50-58 ft), 5 walk-in (046-050); all 44 drive-in sites fit 23 ft, read 2026-11-07

facilities.source: https://mostateparks.com/park/hawn/camping (amenity symbols: amphitheater, dump station, frost-free water, laundry, playground, running water, shower, vault toilet; 'During the off-season, potable water is available behind campsites 41 and 100 and near the fee booth'), read 2026-11-07

values.note: Every site is on the reservation system, reservations March 1-November 30 (online up to 12 months ahead or at 877-422-6766); 'Reservable sites may be available on a walk-up registration basis if the site is not reserved.' No minimum stay on the grid. Park gates close at 10 pm Sunday-Thursday and 11 pm Friday-Saturday. 15 days in any 30.

booking.source: https://mostateparks.com/park/hawn/camping (campground table 'Reservations Mar 1-Nov 30'; walk-up line; 'Park gates close at 10 p.m. Sunday through Thursday and 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday'; 15-in-30 rule) + UseDirect grid PlaceId 42 (AllowWebBooking true on all 49 units, MinStay 1), read 2026-11-07

note: Pine-shaded campground near Pickle Creek; the five walk-in sites by the creek are tent-only. Backpack camping on the Whispering Pine and Spanish Land Grant trails. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $14-15 basic base, electric +12, 2026/2027 identical; sites 50 -> 49 (44 drive-in to 58 ft + 5 walk-in), 50A electric; added facilities, military $2 discount, reservation season Mar 1-Nov 30; PIN 1.5 km off.
